# How to turn Triki on and off?
Make sure Triki is turned on and try to reconnect.
The selected Triki is locked in update mode. Please wait - do not close the app. After the update is complete, you will be able to select the device from the list.
You can start the game, but Triki may turn off during gameplay.
Allow Bluetooth access to connect Triki.
